source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Αλέξανδρος του Βόσκιϋ»

attestations.note: The page says outright that it has nothing: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέριες για τον βίο του Ρώσου μοναχού Αλέξανδρου» — we have no details of the life of the Russian monk Alexander. So the entry gives a rank, a nation and a place name, Βόσκιϋ, and no year, no house and no hymn. The place is recorded only in saint.gr's Greek spelling; no Russian source was read for it, and the English form of the epithet here follows that spelling and is not taken from a Russian page.
